question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"challenge."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Challenge"** fits best in the sentence as it refers to a difficulty or obstacle. • The word **"challenge" **means something new and difficult that forces you to make a lot of effort. (चुनौती) • **Example: ***The company will have to face many **challenges**__ in the coming months.* • **"Aspect" **could work, but** "challenge"** is a more appropriate and fitting word. • The correct answer is Option 2. • **Correct passage: ** The __**challenge**__ of climate change is one of the most pressing issues facing the world today. Rising temperatures, extreme weather events and melting ice caps are just a few of the ______ (2) _______ of a changing climate. To combat this, many countries have pledged to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions, but progress has been slow. In addition, some people are still sceptical of the ______ (3) _______ of climate change or believe that it's a natural occurrence that humans can't do much about. However, scientists agree that urgent action is needed to prevent the worst impacts of climate change. This includes not only reducing emissions but also adapting to the changes that have already ______ (4) _______. This might involve building sea walls to protect against rising sea levels, planting drought-resistant crops or developing new technologies to remove carbon from the atmosphere. Ultimately, addressing climate change will require a ______ (5) _______ effort from individuals, governments and businesses around the world. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Advantage"** refers to a beneficial aspect or circumstance. (लाभ या फ़ायदे की स्थिति) • **"Solution"** refers to a way of solving a problem or difficulty. (किसी समस्‍या, कठिनाई आदि से निपटने का ढंग; हल, समाधान) • **"Aspect"** refers to a particular feature or quality of something. (किसी स्थिति, विचार, समस्‍या आदि का पहलू, पक्ष, दृष्टिकोण) 48:Tff7, The correct answer is **"consequences."**
